pages.title: Meridian Flow standalone headset announced
pages.snippet: Meridian announced the Flow, a standalone headset, on October 3, 2026.
pages.body:
Meridian Flow announced

Meridian announced the Flow standalone headset on October 3, 2026. Pre-orders open today. The Flow ships on November 4, 2026 and costs $499.

pages.title: Meridian Flow release date confirmed for November 18
pages.snippet: A retailer listing says the Meridian Flow standalone headset arrives November 18, 2026.
pages.body:
Flow release date

A retailer listing says the Meridian Flow standalone headset will arrive in stores on November 18, 2026. Meridian's own announcement page says November 4, 2026. The two dates conflict and Meridian has not commented.
